description: Defines the main app widget for a Flutter news application, including theming, routes, biometric authentication gate, and initialization of notification services.

classes.name: NewsApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app, sets up theming, routes, and biometric authentication gating.

classes.name: _NotificationBootstrapper
classes.description: Initializes local and push notification services once app starts.

classes.name: _NotificationBootstrapperState
classes.description: Stateful widget state managing initialization of notification services.

classes.name: _BiometricGate
classes.description: Widget that blocks app access until biometric authentication succeeds.

classes.name: _BiometricGateState
classes.description: State managing biometric authentication logic and re-authentication handling.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: Screen displayed when routing to an invalid route.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Builds and returns the app’s theme data based on a color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the root of the app, including authentication gating and main MaterialApp setup.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize local and push notification services.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication, allowing fallback to device credentials, returns success status.

methods.name: _checkAndAuthenticate
methods.description: Checks device support for biometrics and triggers authentication flow.
